The Sound After the Ball Landed

球落地之后的那声响 · 641 词 · 8 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A school television club filmed the final of a tennis tournament. Its freelance photographer, Niko, sent a dramatic shot to the nightly bulletin. It showed a ball land near the line and an opponent turn away. A bright flash seemed to catch him hitting the net in frustration. The anchor planned a headline about shameful behavior. A producer encouraged him to add a suggestive caption. Then a media teacher asked Niko to bring the entire segment, with its audio. She thought a wide image might give a different impression from the brief preview.

2The original footage showed a raised arm after a whistle. In the streaming preview, the commentator's shout came before the ball landed. A blog called the timing evidence of a punch. Another reader saw a smash. The clip gained popularity, and the same claim spread through TV and social media. A quick poll asked which explanation viewers believed. Its statistic measured reactions, not accuracy. Both pictures looked equally convincing when someone watched only a bit of the broadcast.

3Niko put on headphones and found another shot from the opposite court. Its exposure was poor, and the player looked like a blur. A bright flash near a mirror was still visible through the lens. Niko tapped the touchscreen to enlarge it, then swiped between the recordings. The flash was a point of verification. No imaging sophistication was necessary. They could see graphically that picture and sound had separated during the webcast. The player's hand went up after the whistle.

4A columnist had already repeated the rumor. A correspondent asked the player's guardian for a denial. Niko preferred to interview the player himself. The interviewee said he had raised his hand because a ball had rolled onto the court from the next match. Niko asked him where it came from. He pointed to the far corner. In the wider frame, a faint round shape crossed a white shirt before dropping to the floor. Enlarging the picture made it recognizable. The tighter shot had left out the reason for the signal.

5Another concern came up when a parent recognized the boy in a different upload. An editor had used makeup and lighting for a staged preview. It looked more dramatic than reality. A producer wanted the clip to highlight a youthful personality, but the guardian asked about consent. Niko agreed to separate entertainment from evidence. A seemingly innocent close-up could identify whoever wore the white shirt, whether or not the caption said his name.

6At the editorial briefing a contributor suggested three stills to clarify the sequence. A spokeswoman wanted a vague announcement instead. She feared publicity would give the rumor wider circulation. Niko played a podcast that had repeated the claim. Its host had treated a sketchy clip as fact. A graphic could show the breadth of the court and what the close shot omitted. A newsroom memo approved the correction before the nightly bulletin.

7The club published a correction with the original clip. A blogger asked why an icon still linked to the wrong category. Niko explained the omission and changed it from gossip to news. An editor suggested a wider shot that would show the court's dimensions. The director said the still pictures were enough. One headset held the original audio. The close-up made an awkward movement look suggestive. Viewers deserved a chance to check the order themselves without being told what emotion to see.

8At the next match the player grinned at the camera, then whispered a greeting. Niko filmed wide coverage before close photography, particularly when someone shouted nearby. A youthful volunteer wanted to publish the dramatic photo immediately. Niko asked him to review the submission in its entirety. A hasty edit could confuse a tiny movement with an incredible event. He let the younger photographer find the ball for himself before he approved the shot.

四级汇总词汇 · 12中文译文

球落地之后的那声响

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1学校电视社拍了一场网球决赛。自由摄影师尼科把一个很有戏剧性的镜头发给晚间简报。球落在线边，对手转过身去。闪光一亮，看起来像他气恼地拍打球网。主播准备以失态为标题，制作人还想加一句暗示性的说明。媒体课老师请尼科拿来带声音的完整片段。她觉得，广角画面给人的印象可能和短预告不同。

2原始录像里，球员是在哨响后举起手臂。网络预览里，评论员却在球落地前就喊了一声。博客把这个先后次序当成打球网的证据，另一位读者却说球员是用力扣球。片段越来越火，说法也传到电视和社交媒体。快速投票问观众相信哪一种。数字能反映大家的反应，却不能证明哪种说法准确。只看转播的一小段，两种解释都像有道理。

3尼科戴上耳机，找来球场对面拍的一段录像。曝光不好，球员只剩模糊的轮廓，但镜面旁的闪光仍然看得见。他在触屏上放大，再左右滑动对照两份录像。闪光是核对时间的依据。无需复杂的图像技术，就能看出直播时画面与声音分开了。球员确实是哨响以后才举手。

4专栏作者已经重复了传闻。有记者请球员的监护人出面否认。尼科选择采访球员本人。对方说，隔壁比赛有个球滚进来，他才举手。尼科问球是从哪来的，球员指向远角。宽镜头里，一个淡淡的圆形从白衬衫前掠过，再掉到地上。放大后可以辨认出那是球。特写正好把举手的原因漏掉了。

5另一次上传引起了家长的注意，他认出片中的男孩。编辑为了摆拍预告用了化妆和灯光，画面比实况更戏剧化。制作人想突出球员年轻活泼的形象，监护人却问有没有取得同意。尼科同意把娱乐片段和证据分开。看起来无害的特写就足以认出穿白衬衫的人，即便字幕没写名字。

6编辑会上一名供稿者建议用三张定格画面说清顺序。女发言人想发一条含糊的公告，怕关注多了会让传闻传得更广。尼科放了一段复述传闻的播客，主播把一个信息不全的片段当成事实。示意图可以展示整座球场，以及特写没拍进去的部分。编辑部批了更正，在晚间简报前发出。

7电视社把更正和原片一起发了出来。有博主问，为什么图标还是链到错的栏目。尼科解释了遗漏，把分类从传闻改为新闻。一名编辑想用更广的镜头表现球场尺寸，导演说现有定格图就够了。耳机还保留着原始声音。特写把一个不太自然的动作拍得像有什么隐情。观众应该有机会亲自核对先后顺序，再决定自己看见了什么。

8下场比赛，球员冲镜头咧嘴一笑，低声问候。尼科先拍广角，再拍特写，尤其是旁边有人喊时。一位年轻志愿者想马上发出那张戏剧性的照片。尼科请他从头到尾看过材料。匆忙剪辑能把一个小动作变成难以置信的大事。他先让年轻摄影师自己找到那个球，再同意用那张照片。
